standard_prerequisites: Chapter lemma-independence-characters (source lines 1675-1713, monoid version): pairwise distinct monoid homomorphisms into a field are linearly independent over the target
Every nonzero element of the field K is a unit, and a morphism of extensions sends 0 to 0, so two F-morphisms of K that agree on the units agree on all of K
core_obligations: Restrict the sigma_i to the group of units K*, giving monoid characters into L
Pairwise distinctness of the sigma_i descends: if sigma_i and sigma_j agreed on all units they would agree on every nonzero element and, sending 0 to 0, on all of K
The independence of characters yields coefficients not all zero having a nonzero combination at some g in K*, which is an alpha in K with sum lambda_i sigma_i(alpha) nonzero
proof_roadmap: Descend to characters on the unit group
Apply character independence and land back in K
